mu_name_from: MODEL_ALBATROSS_BOW (MODEL_BOW + 22), loaded from Item/CW_Bow.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1104). Ours is named Bow23 by the index-plus-one rule; MU never loads a Bow23 file. Group 4 number 22 in OpenMU S6 Weapons.cs:238.
why_this_one: The 100-140 weapons MU has and this game lacked (the user, 2026-10-22: 'we need those low level items now', every class's but the Dark Lord's); the first four, one a class, lowest first.

stats.call_note: The Season 6 CreateWeapon: group, number, slot, skill, width, height, dropsFromMonsters, name, dropLevel, minimumDamage, maximumDamage, attackSpeed, durability, magicPower, levelRequirement, strength, agility, energy, vitality, then darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel, magicGladiatorClassLevel, darkLordClassLevel, summonerClassLevel, ragefighterClassLevel.
stats.class_level_note: The Muse Elf's alone: OpenMU's elfClassLevel 2. sim::fits asks Wearer::second (docs/game/second-class-gear.md).

stance_from: CharacterManager's bows count MODEL_ALBATROSS_BOW (ZzzEffectMagicSkill.cpp:273), so PLAYER_STOP_BOW and PLAYER_WALK_BOW; held level (ZzzObject.cpp:5398).
fires_from: ZzzEffectMagicSkill.cpp:248: `case MODEL_ALBATROSS_BOW: CreateEffect(MODEL_ARROW_RING, ...)`. Not built: the missiles are an arrow and a bolt (the user, 2026-10-03), so the wooden arrow.
sheet_from: Data/Item/elfw3_06.OZT (64x128, the dark green limbs with a pale horn tip, mesh 0, 310 triangles, 1% cut), elfw_06.OZJ (64x64, green leaves, mesh 1) and elfw2_06.OZJ (64x16, a pink-white band, mesh 2), decoded from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
material_overrides_note: As the Arrow Viper Bow's lacquered limbs: a shallow cast grain, no blade streaks, no specks.
glow_note: RenderPartObjectBody's MODEL_ALBATROSS_BOW arm (ZzzObject.cpp:7717-7724): HiddenMesh 1, the body drawn plain, then mesh 1 (the leaves) again with BlendMesh 1, added -- here out of the bake and added; mesh 2 (elfw2_06, the pink-white tips) RENDER_TEXTURE | RENDER_BRIGHT, which MU draws added (ZzzBMD.cpp:1534-1537, EnableAlphaBlend) -- here out of the bake and added too; and mesh 2 again RENDER_CHROME5 at 0.5, a faint sheen this cook has no RENDER_CHROME5 coordinates for, not carried. ItemObjectAttribute scales it 0.7 (:5221) and holds it level (:5398). PartObjectColor2 gives it Color 26 (:6644).
release_from: Key 4 of this rig's six, as the Celestial Bow's: Box01 (bone 38), the nock, draws back -34.0, -44.4, -63.7, -74.1 and snaps to +1.3 on key 4. 4/6.
